name: Gem of Brightness

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Shine
powers.text: Magic action: the gem sheds bright light 30 ft and dim light 30 ft more (no charges).

powers.name: Blinding Ray
powers.text: 1 charge: a ray at a creature within 60 ft: a DC 15 Con save or Blinded for 1 minute.

powers.name: Blinding Flare
powers.text: 5 charges: a 30-ft cone of blinding light: a DC 15 Con save or Blinded for 1 minute.

summary: 50 charges: light, a blinding ray (1) or a blinding cone of light (5), Con DC 15.
text: A crystal prism holding 50 charges. While holding it, speak one of its three command words as a Magic action. Light (no charge): the gem gives off Bright Light out to 30 feet and Dim Light for 30 feet more. Ray (1 charge): a dazzling beam strikes a creature within 60 feet that you can see, which must pass a Constitution saving throw (DC 15) or spend 1 minute with the Blinded condition; it can retry the save as each of its turns ends. Flare (5 charges): a 30-foot Cone of searing light forces every creature in it to make that same save. Once the last charge is spent, the gem becomes an ordinary jewel worth 50 GP.
